cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.linewidth": 1.2, })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" INK = "#263238" GRAY = "#B9C5C9"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100)
fig.text( 0.5, 0.954, "Orthogonality of fourth-root Fourier basis vectors", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, weight="semibold" ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.901, r"$u_{k,n}=\omega_4^{kn},\quad \omega_4=e^{2\pi i/4}=i," r"\quad n=0,1,2,3$ • Hermitian inner product; dimensionless", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9 )
left_rows = [ r"$n=0:\quad 1\cdot 1=1$", r"$n=1:\quad (-i)\cdot(-1)=+i$", r"$n=2:\quad (-1)\cdot 1=-1$", r"$n=3:\quad (+i)\cdot(-1)=-i$", ] right_rows = [ r"$n=0:\quad 1\cdot 1=+1$", r"$n=1:\quad (-i)\cdot(-i)=-1$", r"$n=2:\quad (-1)\cdot(-1)=+1$", r"$n=3:\quad (+i)\cdot(+i)=-1$", ]
for x, color, number, m, p, rows, product in [ (0.045, BLUE, 1, 2, 1, left_rows, r"$\overline{u_{1,n}}\,u_{2,n}=\omega_4^{(2-1)n}=i^n$"), (0.545, TEAL, 2, 3, 2, right_rows, r"$\overline{u_{1,n}}\,u_{3,n}=\omega_4^{(3-1)n}=(-1)^n$"), ]: fig.text( x, 0.839, rf"Example {number}: $\langle u_1,u_{m}\rangle$", fontsize=11.5, weight="semibold", color=color, va="center" ) fig.text( x, 0.788, rf"Difference $p=m-k={p}$", fontsize=9.5, va="center" ) fig.text(x, 0.721, product, fontsize=11, va="center") for y, row in zip([0.655, 0.602, 0.549, 0.496], rows): fig.text(x + 0.018, y, row, fontsize=10.5, va="center")
def complex_circle(rect, color, repeated=False): ax = fig.add_axes(rect) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.62, 1.62) ax.set_ylim(-1.48, 1.48) ax.axis("off") ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, edgecolor=GRAY, linewidth=1)) ax.annotate("", xy=(1.37, 0), xytext=(-1.36, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=GRAY, lw=0.8)) ax.annotate("", xy=(0, 1.32), xytext=(0, -1.30), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=GRAY, lw=0.8)) ax.text(1.40, -0.24, "Re", fontsize=7, color=INK, ha="center") ax.text(0.14, 1.29, "Im", fontsize=7, color=INK, va="center") if repeated: ax.scatter([1, -1], [0, 0], s=38, color=color, zorder=4) ax.scatter([1, -1], [0, 0], s=83, facecolors="none", edgecolors=color, linewidths=0.8, zorder=3) ax.text(1.04, 0.20, r"$+1$", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=color) ax.text(-1.05, 0.20, r"$-1$", ha="center", fontsize=9, color=color) ax.text(0.82, -0.43, r"$n=0,2$", ha="center", fontsize=7.2) ax.text(-0.82, -0.43, r"$n=1,3$", ha="center", fontsize=7.2) else: z = np.exp(2j * np.pi * np.arange(4) / 4) ax.scatter(z.real, z.imag, s=30, color=color, zorder=4) for px, py, label, ha, va in [ (1.12, 0.16, r"$1$", "left", "bottom"), (-0.15, 1.12, r"$i$", "right", "bottom"), (-1.12, 0.16, r"$-1$", "right", "bottom"), (-0.12, -1.13, r"$-i$", "right", "top"), ]: ax.text(px, py, label, ha=ha, va=va, fontsize=9, color=color) return ax
complex_circle([0.060, 0.173, 0.191, 0.282], BLUE) complex_circle([0.560, 0.173, 0.191, 0.282], TEAL, repeated=True)
fig.text(0.274, 0.343, "Four distinct terms", fontsize=9, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.274, 0.282, r"$1+i-1-i=0$", fontsize=12, color=BLUE) fig.text(0.774, 0.343, "Two terms, each twice", fontsize=9, color=TEAL) fig.text(0.774, 0.282, r"$1-1+1-1=0$", fontsize=12, color=TEAL)
fig.text( 0.5, 0.092, r"For $k\ne m$:" r"$\qquad \langle u_k,u_m\rangle" r"=\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\omega_N^{(m-k)n}=0$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12 ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.026, r"$\omega_N=e^{2\pi i/N},\quad k,m\in\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$" " (unnormalized Fourier basis)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5 )
